remaining_sorry.reason: Statement is false as written. Counterexample: p=[], q=[0], dims=[5] gives LHS=[0], RHS=[5]. The default value 0 used for out-of-range indices breaks the composition identity when q has indices not in range of p. A correct statement would require a hypothesis that all indices in q are within bounds of p.
remaining_sorry.action: Left with sorry + explanatory comment documenting the falsity.
